name: dev-stack
description: Stack skills for a .NET 10 team: C#, ASP.NET Core, OpenAPI, FluentValidation, EF Core, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, tests with MSTest 4, analyzers, logs and metrics, Redis caching, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Wolverine, MailKit, PuppeteerSharp, secure coding, and the migration from FluentAssertions to AwesomeAssertions. Each skill gives version-specific rules, a check step with a tool, and one report format. Output in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English or Begrijpelijk Nederlands (B1).
